_source.dataset: DoD Area Cost Factors, CONUS (UFS 3-701-01 Table 4-1)
_source.edition: UFS 3-701-01 2026 Data Tables workbook, Table 4-1 CONUS (list dated 06-06-2026 on the WBDG page)
_source.how_to_apply: Table 4-1 provides area cost factors (ACFs) to be used for adjusting “bare” unit costs to location-specific costs for the most common locations.
_source.scaling: a final ACF that reflects the relative relationship of construction costs between that location and the 96-Base-City average as 1.00
_source.application_limit: Do not use the MILCON ACFs to modify detailed quantity take-offs, unit price book (UPB) line items, commercial cost data, or user-generated unit costs.
_source.data_source_statement: CONUS survey covered 213 locations that included 96 Base Cities (two per state in the continental U.S.)
_source.units: area_cost_factor and sustainment_acf are multipliers; the 96-Base-City average = 1.00
